description: Visual editor for Kconfig files with syntax highlighting, auto-completion, validation and menuconfig interface
configuration.title: Kconfig Visual Editor
config.enableValidation: Enable syntax validation for Kconfig files
config.autoHeaderPath: Path to write the generated C header file (default: config.h in the same directory as .config). Supports absolute paths or paths relative to .config directory
config.uiTheme: Select the UI theme used by the menuconfig webview
config.debug.title: Debug
config.debug.enabled: Enable debug mode to show detailed logs in the output panel
config.debug.menu: Enable menu-specific debug logging for troubleshooting menu loading issues
config.log.title: Logging
config.log.enabled: Enable general logging for Kconfig operations
config.log.level: Set the logging level (debug, info, warning, error)
config.log.outputChannel: Show logs in VS Code output panel
config.smartLazyLoad.title: Smart Lazy Loading
config.smartLazyLoad.enabled: Enable smart lazy loading to improve performance with large Kconfig files
config.smartLazyLoad.threshold: Number of menu items threshold for triggering lazy loading
config.smartLazyLoad.maxDepth: Maximum depth for initial menu tree expansion
config.smartLazyLoad.cacheSize: Cache size for loaded menu items
config.validation.title: Validation
config.validation.checkSymbolReferences: Verify that symbol references are valid
config.rtThread.pkgsDir:
### RT-Thread
Configure the `PKGS_DIR` path used to resolve RT-Thread packages. The extension auto-detects common locations and updates this field with the detected value when possible.
